data.name: Muhtarim
data.gender_notes: Muhtarim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ahtar', meaning 'to love, cherish, or desire'. In Islamic contexts, the name Muhtarim signifies a beloved and cherished one, often used to describe a dear friend or family member. The name Muhtarim carries the meaning “Beloved, cherished one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhtarim usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, cherished one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of deep love and attachment, representing the connection between believers and their faith, or between loved ones in a spiritual sense.
data.etymology: Muhtarim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved, cherished one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhtarim total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مختارم
in_arabic.meaning: المختارم يعني الشخص الذي يتم اختياره بعناية فائقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: المختارم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، يعني الشخص الذي يتم اختياره بعناية فائقة، والمقصود به هنا الشخص الذي يتمتع بالاحترام والكرامة، وقد جاء هذا الاسم من الجذر العربي 'خ-ت-ر' الذي يعني الاختيار والانتقاء بعناية، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَيَخْتَارُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ اخْتِيَارُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ' (آل عمران: 124)، ويشير إلى معنى الاختيار الإلهي للأنبياء والرسل.

in_urdu.name: مختارم
in_urdu.meaning: مختارم کا مطلب ہے احتیاط سے منتخب کردہ شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: مختارم ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے احتیاط سے منتخب کردہ شخص، اور یہ نام عربی جڑ 'خ-ت-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے احتیاط سے انتخاب کرنا، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں احترام اور عزت کے ساتھ منسلک ہے، اور اس کا ذکر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے ثقافتی سیاق میں بھی کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुख्तारिम
in_hindi.meaning: मुख्तारिम का अर्थ है सावधानी से चुना हुआ व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुख्तारिम एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है सावधानी से चुना हुआ व्यक्ति, और यह नाम अरबी मूल 'خ-ت-ر' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है सावधानी से चुनना, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: مختارم
in_pashto.meaning: مختارم دى هغه چا چې په احتیاط سره غوره شوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مختارم یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې دى هغه چا چې په احتیاط سره غوره شوی، او دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'خ-ت-ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چی معنی یې په احتیاط سره انتخاب کول، او دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې د احترام او عزت سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Muhtarim
in_english.meaning: Respected, carefully chosen or selected person
in_english.long_meaning: Muhtarim is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning a person who is carefully chosen or selected with respect, it is derived from the Arabic root 'خ-ت-ر' which means to choose or select with care, this name appears in several contexts within Islamic tradition and is associated with respect, dignity, and spiritual significance, reflecting the careful selection or choice by Allah.

historical_references.reference: Muhtarib billah was a title given to the commander of the Muslim army during the siege of Constantinople (674-678 AD). He was a Berber general named Al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah al-Makhzumi al-Qurashi. Muhtarib billah means 'God's chosen commander'.
historical_references.context: During the Caliphate of Mu'awiya I, the Muslims under the command of Muhtarib billah laid siege to Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine Empire. The siege lasted for five years, but ultimately failed due to lack of resources and manpower.

historical_references.reference: Muhtar ibn Abi Bakr Rasid al-Dinawari (d. 852 AD) was a prominent Shi'a scholar and theologian during the Abbasid Caliphate. He was known as Muhtarim al-Dinari, meaning 'the learned Muhtar'.
historical_references.context: Muhtar ibn Abi Bakr was a pupil of the renowned scholar and theologian Ibn Babawayh al-Qummi. He authored several works on Islamic jurisprudence and theology, and was known for his extensive knowledge in these fields.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Muhtarim holds significant meaning in Islamic spirituality, particularly within Sufism. Muhtarim translates to 'consolers' in English, and is often used to refer to those who offer comfort, support, and guidance to those on their spiritual journey. In modern contexts, the name is commonly used on platforms such as Reddit, Instagram, and Quora to describe individuals who provide emotional and spiritual support to others, often through sharing personal stories, wisdom, and advice. The trend of seeking out Muhtarim figures online reflects a growing interest in self-improvement and spiritual growth within the digital sphere.
